title: Changes to Student visa application rules (subclasses 500 and 590)
body: From 2 October 2026, changes to Student (subclass 500) and Student Guardian (subclass 590) visas affect who may apply or receive a visa while in Australia and when family members may be included. The rules do not mean that every student application is banned. Check the detailed Home Affairs guidance for your circumstances.

title: Applying for a Student or Student Guardian visa while in Australia
body: Under the rules from 2 October 2026, most affected temporary visa holders must be outside Australia when lodging a Student or Student Guardian application and when the visa is granted. Some current Student visa holders have limited exceptions when applying for a further Student visa. The changes do not affect a current Student visa. Home Affairs lists the affected visas and exceptions.

title: Including or adding family members to a Student visa
body: Most new Student visa applicants cannot include a partner or dependent child unless a listed exemption applies. A family member cannot be added as a subsequent entrant after the Student visa is granted; Home Affairs says there is no exemption to that later-addition rule.

title: Changes to the legislative framework for overseas students
body: From 2 October 2026 until 30 June 2027, the provider-transfer restriction for non-school overseas students is temporarily 12 months instead of six. The Post-Higher Education Work stream is for eligible degree-level graduates; the Post-Vocational Education Work stream is for eligible associate degree, diploma or trade graduates whose qualification relates to an occupation Australia needs. Check the stream-specific Home Affairs criteria and required evidence; completing a course does not by itself establish eligibility.
